# proxmox_user_token (Resource)

Manages a Proxmox VE API token through `/access/users/{userid}/token/{tokenid}`. The token `value` (secret) is only returned once at creation time and is preserved in state; it cannot be read back from Proxmox.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_user_token" "ci" {
  user_id  = proxmox_user.deploy.user_id
  token_id = "ci"
  comment  = "CI automation token"
  privsep  = true
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `token_id` (String) User-specific token identifier. Changes require replacement.
- `user_id` (String) Full User ID in `name@realm` format. Changes require replacement.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Optional token comment.
- `expire` (Number) Token expiration date (seconds since epoch). 0 means no expiration.
- `privsep` (Boolean) Restrict API token privileges with separate ACLs (default true).

### Read-Only

- `full_token_id` (String) Full token ID in `userid!tokenid` format.
- `id` (String) Identifier in `userid/tokenid` form.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) API token value (secret). Only available at creation time.
